mainText: Hello, Verona! At 1 PM, here is today's balanced dish. We have clear skies near the Verona Public Library with a comfortable feel of 77 degrees. If you are heading out tonight, look toward the northwest over Verona High School around 9:33 PM; the space station will be visible for six minutes as it travels toward Fitchburg, reaching halfway up the sky.

If you are looking to stay connected, VHAT is your dedicated government and public access channel, offering local meeting coverage and community updates on channel 989 or online. Also, remember that home composting is a great way to manage yard waste, with free food scrap drop-offs available at Badger Prairie County Park for registered users.

There is plenty to do this week in Verona! You can catch trivia at Hop Haus on Thursday or Lake Louie on Tuesday, enjoy the downtown farmer's market on Wednesday, or listen to live music at Paddy Mac's and Century School Park later in the week.
On July 13, local officers responded to a report of a vehicle stuck on a large rock, which resulted in the driver being arrested for a first-offense operating while intoxicated charge.
Treat yourself to the Chocolate Caramel Twist today! The restaurant is open until 10 PM, so you have plenty of time to stop by for a scoop. If you miss it, tomorrow's flavor will be Mint Explosion.
